name: Amazon RDS and Aurora
sku: Amazon RDS for its six engines (Db2, MariaDB, SQL Server, MySQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL) and Amazon Aurora, which is MySQL- and PostgreSQL-compatible and is part of RDS. Scored as one record because both are managed through RDS.

source.oltp.note: Managed relational databases that AWS sets up, operates and scales, on six engines including PostgreSQL and Oracle. Aurora is part of the same service.

bands.note: AWS handles scaling, high availability, backups, patching and failure recovery, with Multi-AZ standbys and read replicas. Query tuning stays with the customer. It manages the database's infrastructure, not yours.
Metrics go to CloudWatch every minute, with alarms, Performance Insights for database load and Enhanced Monitoring for operating-system metrics.

presentation.tagline: Managed relational databases for application data, including Aurora.
